entry.name: apiKey
entry.label: DeepSeek API key used to read the account balance.

entry.name: balanceField
entry.label: Which balance value is shown in the panel.

entry.name: preferredCurrency
entry.label: Preferred currency, or empty to use the first one returned.

entry.name: lowBalanceThreshold
entry.label: Warn when the selected balance drops below this value. Zero disables the warning.

entry.name: showCurrencyCode
entry.label: Show the ISO currency code next to the symbol.

entry.name: spentToday
entry.label: Estimated spend for the current local day, in spendCurrency.

entry.name: spendDay
entry.label: Local date (yyyy-MM-dd) that spentToday belongs to.

entry.name: spendCurrency
entry.label: Currency that spentToday is expressed in.

entry.name: spendLastTotal
entry.label: Last observed total balance, diffed against the next refresh.
